name: memory_session_proof_line_update
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_session_proof_line_update AFTER UPDATE ON messages
 WHEN (OLD.json IS NOT NEW.json AND (instr(OLD.json,'withheldFromBots')>0 OR instr(NEW.json,'withheldFromBots')>0 OR instr(OLD.json,'copyOf')>0 OR instr(NEW.json,'copyOf')>0)
   AND CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.json) AND json_valid(NEW.json)
     THEN json_extract(OLD.json,'$.copyOf') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.json,'$.copyOf') OR json_extract(OLD.json,'$.withheldFromBots') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.json,'$.withheldFromBots')
     ELSE 1 END) AND CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.json) AND json_valid(NEW.json)
 THEN json_extract(OLD.json,'$.copyOf') IS NOT json_extract(NEW.json,'$.copyOf') OR
 (json_extract(NEW.json,'$.withheldFromBots') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(NEW.json,'$.withheldFromBots') NOT IN (0,'')) ELSE 1 END
 BEGIN INSERT INTO memory_session_change_log(id) VALUES('line:'||OLD.thread_id||char(0)||OLD.id); END

   AND c.native_session=NEW.native_session AND c.up_to>=NEW.rowid)
 BEGIN INSERT INTO memory_session_change_log(id) VALUES('receipt:'||NEW.bundle_id); END
